snippet.title: The Real Face of a VTuber - STEAM Release Announcement
snippet.description:
A murder takes place in a VTuber studio. Multiple streamers claim to be the same person. All of them insist they were live during the crime.

Step into the courtroom as a prosecutor determined to reveal who’s really behind the avatar. Question. Object. Deduce. Every truth you find hides another layer of lies.

The Real Face of a VTuber — launching January 13 on STEAM. Unmask the truth...
